summary: Replaced greedy selection with a global branch-and-bound assignment optimizer, including civil-time fold/gap resolution, directed consecutive-person transitions, dependency timing, room blocks, and deterministic objective tie breaking. Added regression tests and an independent exhaustive oracle.
tests_run: functions.tests: public.test.mjs and candidate.test.mjs; 8 tests passed, 0 failed
100 deterministic randomized six-meeting cases compared against an independent exhaustive leaf validator
limitations: Search is exponential in the number of meetings; designed for the specified maximum of 10 meetings and 3 rooms.
Civil-time resolution relies on Node Intl timezone data and is scoped to the specified zones and years.
Inputs are assumed well formed as specified; no live calendar access or external calls are performed.
